name: University of Surrey
typicalOffer: ABB, Biology and one of applied science, chemistry, maths, further maths, physics, psychology, nutrition and food science, physical education or geography

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: AAB, At least one of biology or chemistry, plus a second science-based subject

name: Queen Margaret University
typicalOffer: BCC, Typically Biology and Chemistry required and one further science preferred (can include Maths or Home Economics); English and Maths at Nat 5/GCSE grade C/4

name: Cardiff Metropolitan University
typicalOffer: 120 UCAS tariff points, Minimum three A levels. Grades BC in Biology and Chemistry (the B in either); five GCSEs at C/4 including English, Maths and Science
notes: HCPC/BDA accredited. The university quotes a UCAS tariff of 120 points rather than grades; the grades shown are the equivalent of 120 points.

name: University of Plymouth
typicalOffer: 112 UCAS tariff points, Grade C in Biology or Chemistry
notes: HCPC/BDA accredited. The university quotes a UCAS tariff of 112 points rather than grades; the grades shown are the equivalent of 112 points.
